summary: Completed P2 feature testing for Prime Potions ERP. All 15 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests passed for Import Wizard (5-step progress), Traceability (3 tabs), and Dashboard with WebSocket.

minor.issue: Some transactions in DB missing item_type, location_id, status fields - FIXED by making response model fields optional

critical_code_review_comments: Batching import supports STRICT/FLEXIBLE modes based on recipe_required toggle
Import Wizard has 5-step flow: Upload → Select Sheet → Map Columns → Preview → Complete
Traceability page has 3 tabs: Trace Lot, Where Used, History
Dashboard loads with WebSocket subscription for live updates
seed_data_creation: Test batch created via batching import (TEST-BATCH-001)
context_for_next_testing_agent: P2 features tested and working. Key pages: /import-wizard (5-step Import Wizard), /traceability (3-tab Traceability view). Batching import at POST /api/excel/prime-potions/import-batching supports FLEXIBLE mode. Test file at /tmp/test_batch_upload.xlsx.

P2_batching_import_flexible.details: FLEXIBLE mode works - validates items exist, allows manual ingredients, creates batch record and WIP production

P2_import_wizard_analyze.details: Analyzes Excel file, returns sheets with headers and suggested mappings

P2_import_wizard_preview.details: Generates preview of what will be created/updated

P2_traceability_forward.details: Traces from raw material lot to finished goods

P2_traceability_backward.details: Traces from finished good lot back to raw materials

P2_traceability_where_used.details: Finds all batches and filling orders where an item was used

P2_dashboard_websocket.details: Dashboard loads with WebSocket subscription for live updates

frontend_import_wizard.details: 5-step wizard UI with Upload, Select Sheet, Map Columns, Preview, Complete steps. File upload dropzone works.

frontend_traceability.details: 3 tabs: Trace Lot, Where Used, History. Lot number input with recent lots. Direction selector (Forward/Backward).

bug_fix_applied.issue: InventoryTransactionResponse Pydantic validation error - missing required fields
bug_fix_applied.root_cause: Some inventory transactions in database were missing item_type, location_id, status fields
bug_fix_applied.fix: Made these fields Optional in InventoryTransactionResponse model with default values
